name: Symbiosis Guard — Core Cleanliness & Deadline Sentinel
description: Merged task from ahimsa_filter, deadline_sentinel, and task_scanner. Part of RM-013 (Symbiosis Guard). Automated system for honeycomb health checks, deadline monitoring, and file quality validation.
notes: Task scanner was at 90% before merge. Ahimsa filter at 0%. Deadline sentinel planned.
mandala_principles: Ahimsa — maximum token and resource economy

task_scanner.description: Task scanner validates: task_id uniqueness, JSON validity, required fields (task_id, name, status, priority), non-standard statuses, expired deadlines

ahimsa_filter.description: Ahimsa filter detects noise in honeycombs: duplicates, stale files (>30 days), empty files (<500 bytes), broken links, redundant fields, missing layer, zero resonance, old backups (>14 days)
ahimsa_filter.plan: Phase 1: Core Analyzer. Phase 2: Scanner Integration. Phase 3: Interactive Cleanup. Phase 4: CI/CD Integration

deadline_sentinel.description: Deadline monitoring: auto-warnings 2-3 days before deadline, daily morning report. GitHub Issues API, APScheduler. Extension to roadmaps, Honeycomb Scanner API, Git Hooks, GitHub Actions, bot integration.

deliverables: GitHub Actions workflow for automated checks
acceptance_criteria: CI/CD pipeline active on push to main
Zero false positives on critical categories

health.notes: Merged from 3 tasks. Task scanner code ready. Filter and sentinel to implement.
